description: Source code for CPU feature detection and workaround handling on ARM Linux systems within BoringSSL/OpenSSL, including functions for reading system files and CPU capabilities.

methods.name: open_eintr
methods.description: Opens a file with specified flags, retrying if interrupted by a signal.

methods.name: read_eintr
methods.description: Reads from a file descriptor, retrying if interrupted.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a file into a newly allocated buffer.
